jobs.tierReason: auto-approval policy for hand-build windows and git push; a bypass lets a session push or rewrite the repo unattended
jobs.prompt: Ninth static security review of coordination/review/aa-new9.diff: auto-approve v1, now FILE-EDIT WINDOWS ONLY (no git capability at all: every git command stays owner-only as on main; the swarm merge standing path is unchanged). A policy window may auto-approve Write, Edit, NotebookEdit and analysed shell writes of EXACT files with extensions .md .txt .json .ndjson .csv .yaml .yml inside docs/plans, docs/state, docs/scope, docs/design and the routing notes main already allows, never tools, tests, .github, .swarm, .git, job manifests, coordination review files or the project pointer. Promises: exact-file entries only (no folder or prefix match); every written path re-checked at write time against folders and extensions; lstat-based symlink and dangling-symlink rejection; kill switch, expiry, per-window and per-day caps and stats protection on every approval path; stats initialised by the policy with a marker and never fail-open; policy file and override variables ignored outside the signed test marker; SAFE_SWARM anchored and every segment of a compound command tested; ssh and git config files protected; orchestrator mode gains nothing; git behaves exactly as on main. Previous findings (fifth review) that still apply to this scope: folder entries and code files in windows, dangling symlinks, stats never initialised, SAFE_SWARM anchoring, env overrides under the temp dir, protected files. Check each and look for NEW bypasses or fail-open paths, including: any remaining way a policy window can cover a git command or a command that runs code, a window file that is a hard link or a path reached through a symlinked ancestor, case-insensitive filesystem tricks, files inside allowed folders that other tools execute or trust (hooks, CI configs, scripts referenced from docs, package scripts), and the guard paths for shell writes (redirects, tee, sed -i, mv, cp onto a window file from a protected one). No exploit commands. Verdict PASS or FAIL, ranked findings with severity. This is a rebuild on clean main: git and swarm merge handling were supposed to stay identical to main, with all logic in tools/auto-approve-policy.mjs and small hooks in tools/handbuild.mjs and tools/self-approval.mjs. Prior reviews (FAIL) found for the earlier branch: instruction files and dot-folders in allowed folders; hard links and symlinks; link-producing commands; override variables outside the signed test marker; stats bootstrap and poisoning; protected owner files; empty-files Bash allows skipping the re-check; kill switch scope; git and merge handling deviations (project-root policy lookup, basename swarm.mjs matching, absolute-path git classification, merge-only Bash line skipping the guard). Verify that git classification and the swarm merge path are unchanged in substance (list every hunk that touches them and say whether it widens or narrows what is allowed), that each earlier file-window finding is fixed, and look for new bypasses. Verdict PASS or FAIL, ranked findings with severity.
